s_lib_test_mod.config_screen.title: S-Lib Test Mod Config
s_lib_test_mod.config_screen.op_required: Requires Singleplayer or Server Operator permission.
s_lib_test_mod.category.synced.desc: Server-authoritative configuration managed by SyncedConfigManager. Options marked as OVERRIDE_CLIENT are synchronized from the server, while INFORM_SERVER transmits preferences, and NONE remains strictly client-local.
s_lib_test_mod.category.local.desc: Pure local configuration managed by LocalConfigManager. Operates strictly on this client instance with zero network communication. All @Sync annotations are inert.
s_lib_test_mod.title.primitives.desc: Demonstrates basic primitive types, numeric boundaries (@Range annotations), and enums.
s_lib_test_mod.group.primitives.desc: Demonstrates basic primitive types, numeric boundaries (@Range annotations), and enums.
s_lib_test_mod.title.adapters.desc: Demonstrates S-Lib type adapters for AWT Color, Minecraft TextColor, Pattern, Identifier, and UUID.
s_lib_test_mod.group.adapters.desc: Demonstrates S-Lib type adapters for AWT Color, Minecraft TextColor, Pattern, Identifier, and UUID.
s_lib_test_mod.title.network_modes.desc: Demonstrates different synchronization behaviors: OVERRIDE_CLIENT, INFORM_SERVER, and local-only NONE.
s_lib_test_mod.group.network_modes.desc: Demonstrates different synchronization behaviors: OVERRIDE_CLIENT, INFORM_SERVER, and local-only NONE.
s_lib_test_mod.title.visualSettings.desc: Demonstrates multi-level nested POJOs via @Nest annotations.
s_lib_test_mod.group.visualSettings.desc: Demonstrates multi-level nested POJOs via @Nest annotations.
s_lib_test_mod.option.testInt.desc: Integer option clamped within range [-100 to 1000].
s_lib_test_mod.option.testLong.desc: Long integer option clamped within range [-10000 to 100000] with step 500.
s_lib_test_mod.option.testFloat.desc: Floating-point option clamped within range [0.0 to 5.0].
s_lib_test_mod.option.testDouble.desc: Double-precision option clamped within range [-50.0 to 50.0].
AWT Color with alpha channel transparency (RGBA).
s_lib_test_mod.option.chatHighlightColor: Named Minecraft TextColor representing chat accent color.
s_lib_test_mod.option.customRgbTextColor: Minecraft TextColor represented in RGB hex.
s_lib_test_mod.option.itemFilterRegex.de: Compiled regular expression pattern for filtering items.
s_lib_test_mod.option.favoriteWeapon.des: Minecraft Item Identifier (with item & tag selector).
Client preference string sent to server via C2S packet (@Sync(INFORM_SERVER)).
Client integer setting informed to server via C2S packet [0 to 500].
s_lib_test_mod.option.serverDrivenInt.de: Marked @Sync(OVERRIDE_CLIENT) in local config to verify it remains inert and local.
Local-only toggle (@Sync(NONE)) retained strictly on this client.
s_lib_test_mod.option.localDouble.desc: Local-only double [0.5 to 1.5] retained strictly on this client.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visualSettings_ove: Semi-transparent background color for the HUD overlay.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visualSettings_hud: Default text color for HUD widgets.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visualSettings_sub: HUD element animation speed multiplier [0.1 to 10.0].
Name identifier of the visual theme profile.
Render wireframe bounds around HUD widgets for debugging.
s_lib_test_mod.option.translationAliases: Key-value map of string aliases formatted as 'key: value'.
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantmentRules.a: List of enchantment IDs allowed to bypass normal restrictions (comma-separated).
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantmentRules.r: List of enchantment IDs explicitly restricted or forced incompatible (comma-separated).
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantmentRules.m: Level multiplier limit for this enchantment.
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantmentRules.b: Whether this enchantment bypasses vanilla incompatibility checks.
s_lib_test_mod.category.enchantment_allo: Dedicated tab for projected allowed enchantment IDs via categoryFromNestMapList().
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantmentRules.e: Allowed enchantment IDs for this enchantment.
s_lib_test_mod.category.autogen.desc: Fully automatic category generated via .autoGenerate() directly from the config schema.
Dedicated tab for nested category visualSettings projected via categoryFromNest().
s_lib_test_mod.category.enchantment_rule: Dedicated tab for nested POJO map enchantmentRules projected via categoryFromNestMap().
Dedicated tab for nested POJO list tooltipEntries projected via categoryFromNestList().
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.com: Descriptive comment or label for this custom tooltip.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.tex: Comma-separated lines of text rendered inside the custom tooltip.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.pos: Positioning mode of the tooltip relative to vanilla lines.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.tar: Target item or tag identifier to attach this custom tooltip to.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.bol: Render the tooltip header line in bold font.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.ita: Render the tooltip text lines in italic font.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.bac: Opacity of the tooltip background box [0 to 255].
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.uui: Unique persistent identifier for this tooltip entry.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.col: Border accent color formatted as hex/RGB.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltipEntries.tex: Comma-separated list of Minecraft text colors for gradient accents.
